data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's registered attack-defeater warrant pre-pass depends on SRC_013's two-level warrant validity: a defeater's carriage edge is only meaningful once the inner grounded labelling has separated provisional from committed attacks, because the defeater must know which attack edges are warrant-supported before targeting them. Refuted if the defeater pre-pass yields a different surviving attack graph when applied to a single-pass flat warrant graph than when applied after SRC_013's inner labelling.
